dispatch_gate: DISPATCH ∅ — no unit is dispatched under this design until doe-expert approves the DESIGN (approval = doe-expert comment/record naming this campaign); design landing is not dispatch approval (precedent: live-3-phrases-deepseek).
work_order: doe-expert INIT++ WO#1 (2026-10-31), superseding the seed-minimal brief
supersedes: live-4-dispatch-framing (PR #2802, seed-minimal design): same wave + framing family, narrower spec. live-4 status set to superseded in this PR; its records (none) and text retained. This campaign is the wave-framing design of record.

subject.system: Nov-wave build dispatches to Jules via agent-jules-on-issues (issue + jules label)
subject.framing_source: docs/ops/DO-PHRASING-FRAMING-FRAMEWORK.md sections 2+4 (canonical structure; pattern A = Implement/repair, pattern B = Research/find gaps)

design.type: 2x2 factorial: framing (manipulated, assigned) x entry-class (intrinsic classification factor, NOT assignable — recorded before assignment, never relabelled after outcomes)
design.unit_of_observation: one Nov-wave dispatch issue (-> one Jules session -> one PR) = one EXPERIMENT record

framing.definition: Issue body = DO pattern A only (templates/framing-a.md): ACTION+TARGET+OUTCOME+SCOPE+CONSTRAINTS+ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE+STOP/ESCALATION, no pack attached.

Same pattern-A body PLUS a context/evidence pack (templates/framing-ba-pack.md) prepared by the dispatching seat BEFORE dispatch, from pattern-B work: baseline refs (SHAs/paths), primary-source links, observed-vs-expected, known gaps + unknowns stated separately, acceptance-evidence checklist with exact checks. The pack is dispatcher-supplied context; it does not ask the builder to run a recon phase (that was live-4's ba operationalization — superseded, do not mix).

entry_class.definition: Unit builds a new app/surface with no prior landed version in its scope (classification by target scope at issue creation).
Unit changes/refines code or docs with a prior landed version in its scope.

factors.classification_rule: Entry-class is stamped on the assignment ledger BEFORE the framing assignment for that unit is revealed/applied; rationale = one line naming the scope's prior landed state. Post-outcome relabelling is prohibited; disputes resolve to the pre-dispatch stamp.

assignment.mechanism: balanced-alternating per entry, within entry-class strata (taxonomy: assignment mechanism, not a design class)
rule: Within each entry x entry-class stratum, units in dispatch order alternate framing levels; the stratum's starting level = parity of sha256(campaign_id + entry + entry_class) (recorded in the ledger when the stratum opens).

rnd where >=2 same-class units: when >=2 units of the same entry-class in one entry are assigned in the same batch (same dispatch sitting), their framing assignment is a random permutation (order = sha256(campaign_id + issue_number) ascending) instead of positional alternation — batch counts stay balanced.

Rotation constraint (desk rule): no 2 consecutive dispatches in an entry carry the same framing where this mechanism applies; a batch permutation must respect the stratum's last assigned level at the boundary.
assignment.ledger: records/assignments.jsonl — one line per unit appended at assignment time, BEFORE the jules label is applied: {issue, entry, entry_class, entry_class_rationale, framing_assigned, mechanism: alternation|rnd-batch, stratum_position, assigned_by, assigned_at}
assignment.deviations: Any dispatch outside the ledger sequence = OBSERVATIONAL (recorded, never pooled as designed, never retro-dressed). Assignment swaps after issue creation are prohibited; a mis-assigned unit is analysed as-assigned (ITT) with the deviation recorded.

responses.primary: first-pass gate-green (binary): the unit PR's first complete head passes the repo gate (hygiene + portability gate and applicable checks) with no failure conclusion
secondary: review_cycles: count of review rounds on the unit PR (review submissions + review-arm comment rounds, stamped by reviewer instance)
rework_PRs: count of follow-up PRs within 14d of the unit PR's merge whose stated purpose is correcting/completing that PR's work
wall_clock: hours from issue creation to unit PR merge (unmerged units: censored at wave close, recorded as such)
responses.guardrail: a framing level that wins primary but doubles median rework_PRs in either entry-class does not advance (culling guard)

decision_rule.text: Evaluate when n >= 16 designed units with >= 4 per cell, OR at Nov-wave close 2026-12-04, whichever first. Adopt B+A-pack as the default wave framing iff pooled first-pass gate-green advantage >= 0.20 AND advantage >= 0 in EACH entry-class AND guardrail holds; winner is cherry-picked into the dispatch templates/docs by follow-up PR, loser culled with records retained. If the framing x entry-class interaction reverses sign between classes (advantage >= +0.20 in one, <= -0.20 in the other), adopt per-class defaults instead of a pooled winner. Otherwise no_selection: A-implement-only stays default. Verdict recorded vs this rule only.

instance_stamps.protocol: Per dispatch, one EXPERIMENT record in records/ named <entry>-<issue_number>.json, conforming to docs/ops/corpus/EXPERIMENT.schema.json, treatment.arm = framing level, cohort = entry-class.
instance_stamps.configured_instance: {provider: jules, model@version: NOT ESTABLISHED (Jules exposes none), system_prompt: ref prompt:<dispatching-moniker>:<slug> + sha256 of exact dispatched title+body (stamp form ref#sha256[:12]), tools: NOT ESTABLISHED (no tool list exposed), role: builder, moniker: <dispatching seat>, context: live-1-wave-framing/<entry>/<entry-class>}
instance_stamps.instance_key: Computed via scripts/doe/instance_key.py only when the full tuple is established; otherwise null with the NOT ESTABLISHED fields named — never fabricated.
instance_stamps.phrases: Established phrase set for a route => composed into the dispatch and hash-covered; Jules route has none established => phrases = NOT ESTABLISHED (SSOT = {deepseek} only). Phrase cells (live-3 family, phrases-jit now under live-builds) compose per dispatch where a route carries them; they are stamped on the same record, not silently crossed here.
instance_stamps.mapping_key_note: No DOE-FAMILY mapping row changes in this design; if a later amendment alters instance keys, flag viz-dispatch-tree (4ed48ba4) before/with that PR.
